signals.name: Curve move (2y vs 10y over 1m)
signals.rule: bear steepening or bear flattening -1; bull flattening +1; bull steepening 0 (easing, but often recession onset); moves under 5bp 0

signals.name: MOVE index (Treasury implied vol)
signals.read: MOVE 110 (+35 1m); bond vol drives MBS convexity hedging, dealer balance sheets and equity multiples

signals.name: Stock-bond correlation (60d SPY vs TLT)
signals.rule: >+0.3 -1 (bonds do not hedge: inflation/term-premium regime, 1970s and 2022 style); <-0.2 +1 (bonds hedge); else 0

signals.name: Priced Fed path (2-year minus effective fed funds)
signals.rule: bp: >=+50 -2 (a hiking cycle priced); +15..+50 -1; -50..+15 0; <-50 +1 (cuts priced; check growth before cheering)
signals.read: 2y 4.89% vs fed funds 3.88%: +101bp (+30bp 1m); the 2y is the market's two-year Fed forecast

signals.name: Real policy rate (fed funds minus core PCE y/y)
High-yield OAS level
signals.rule: <3.0 +1; 3.0-4.0 0; 4.0-5.5 -1; >=5.5 -2 (tight spreads are benign but leave no cushion)

signals.name: CCC minus HY OAS (the weak tail)
signals.rule: gap percentile over 5y: >=85 -1 (weakest borrowers cracking under high rates while the index looks calm); <=30 +1; else 0

signals.name: Senior loan officers: net % tightening C&I
signals.rule: >=40 -2; 20-40 -1; 0-20 0; <0 +1 (bank credit supply leads defaults by 2-4 quarters)

signals.name: VIX level
signals.rule: <20 +1; 20-25 0; 25-30 -1; >=30 -2 (below 13 is complacency; noted, not scored against)

signals.name: Net Fed liquidity (balance sheet - TGA - RRP)
Funding pressure (SOFR minus IORB, 5-day avg)
signals.rule: bp: >=+10 -2; +3..+10 -1; else 0 (repo above the Fed's floor rate means reserves are getting scarce: Sept 2019)

signals.name: Dollar 3-month change (DXY, else broad index)
signals.rule: %: >=+5 -2; +2..+5 -1; -2..+2 0; <-2 +1 (a falling dollar loosens global financial conditions)

signals.name: Yen carry unwind (USD/JPY 1m change)
signals.rule: %: <=-5 -2; -5..-3 -1; else 0 (a fast yen rally forces deleveraging of funded risk: Aug 2024)

signals.name: Re-steepening after inversion (10y-3m)
signals.rule: -1 when 10y-3m was below -0.5 within 24 months and is now above 0: historically the window when recessions start; else 0

signals.name: Headline CPI momentum (3m annualised vs y/y)
Oil shock gauge (WTI 3m change and level)
Mortgage rate minus 10-year (MBS spread proxy)
signals.rule: bp: <170 +1; 170-250 0; 250-300 -1; >=300 -2 (wide = MBS buyers absent, rate vol high, Fed running off MBS)

signals.name: Building permits, 3m average y/y
signals.rule: %: <=-10 -1; >=+5 +1; else 0 (permits lead starts, employment and builder margins)

signals.name: Case-Shiller national y/y
signals.rule: %: <0 -1 (collateral values falling: bank, MBS and consumer-wealth channel); >=0 0

signals.name: Agency MBS vs Treasuries (MBB / IEF, 3m)
signals.rule: %: >=+1 +1; <=-1 -1; else 0 (MBS underperforming = spread widening, convexity selling)

signals.name: S&P 500 trend (50d, 200d)
signals.rule: above 200d with 50>200 +1; above 200d, 50<200 0; below 200d -1; below with 50<200 and 200d falling -2

judgment.regime_call: Lean risk-off: a hostile discount rate with the first crack in credit
judgment.summary: The discount rate is still the story and it got worse since 2026-09-24: 10y 5.26% (R_10Y_LEVEL, 100th pctile of 20y, 2026-09-29), +53bp in a month (R_10Y_1M), real 10y 2.91% (R_REAL10, +71bp 3m), 30y 5.59% (R_LONG_END), term premium 1.02% (R_TERM_PREMIUM, 2026-09-25) and MOVE 110 (R_MOVE, +35 1m, 2026-09-30). The move is mostly real yield plus a priced Fed: the 2y sits 101bp over fed funds (R_FED_PATH) while breakevens are flat at 2.36% (I_BREAKEVEN), so this is a policy and term-premium repricing, not an inflation scare. The new information this week is credit: HY OAS widened 48bp in a month to 308bp (C_HY_CHANGE, C_HY_LEVEL dropped to 0), and the CCC-HY gap is 849bp at its 5-year high (C_CCC_GAP); that drove the composite from -4.8 to -7.8 (delta, credit pillar -17). Equity vol has not followed (VIX 16.3, VIX/VIX3M 0.89, V_VIX, V_TERM, 2026-09-30) and NFCI is loose (-0.55, L_NFCI, 2026-09-25). Growth is solid (claims 202k 4wk avg G_CLAIMS 2026-09-19; unemployment 4.1% G_UNRATE 2026-08-01), but the tape is narrow: RSP -3.7pp and IWM -9.2pp vs SPY over 3m, 4 of 11 sectors above 200d (E_BREADTH_RSP, E_SMALL_CAPS, E_SECTOR_BREADTH). Stocks and bonds are falling together (R_STOCK_BOND_CORR +0.50), so Treasuries do not hedge. The call stays Lean risk-off: hold quality cash-flow and energy, keep long-duration and rate-sensitive exposure small, and treat the index's strength (SPY -1.5% from high, E_DRAWDOWN) as earnings-carried, not multiple-supported.

drivers.why: real 10y 2.91% (+71bp 3m, as of 2026-09-29): the highest discount rate on distant cash flows since 2007; the main headwind for long-duration growth
10y +53bp in a month, +82bp in three, to 5.26% (2026-09-29); speed de-rates multiples
2y 4.89% vs fed funds 3.88% = +101bp (+30bp 1m, 2026-09-29): a hiking cycle is priced
MOVE 110 (+35 1m, 2026-09-30) against VIX 16.3: bond vol pricing a risk equity vol is not
HY OAS +48bp in a month to 308bp (2026-09-29): new this week, the first confirmation from the index spread
CCC-HY gap 849bp, 100th pctile of 5y, +154bp 3m (2026-09-29): the weak tail is breaking first, the 2007/2015 pattern
WTI $90.3, +31.7% in 3m (2026-09-30): OIL_SHOCK flag; limits the Fed's room to ease
IWM -9.2pp vs SPY in 3m (2026-09-29): rate- and credit-sensitive equities are already pricing the damage

historical_frame.similar: multi-year-high 10y, hiking Fed, tight index credit with the tail widening, narrow leadership
historical_frame.different: an oil shock on top (WTI +31.7% 3m) and a higher starting real yield (2.91% vs about 1.1%); the analog's 12m max drawdown was -7.4% on monthly averages, the intra-quarter fall was about -20%

historical_frame.similar: Fed hiking into growth, long-end rout with MOVE rising, housing hit first (ITB -16.8% vs SPY 3m, H_ITB_REL)
historical_frame.different: breakevens are flat (I_BREAKEVEN 2.36%), so this is real-rate and term-premium driven rather than an inflation-expectations scare

historical_frame.similar: measured hikes, rising oil, housing rolling over while the index grinds higher
historical_frame.different: the term premium is rising (1.02%), not suppressed as in the 'conundrum'

positioning: Risk budget: 60% gross (Lean risk-off), unchanged from 2026-09-24; the rest in T-bills, not long Treasuries, because R_STOCK_BOND_CORR is +0.50

long_duration_growth is a headwind (fit -1.4, runway 1/8): cap pre-profit and speculative growth (e.g. space, biotech platforms such as RKLB, ABCL) at a small sleeve; do not average down while R_REAL10 is rising
quality_megacap is neutral (fit +0.1, runway 4/8): free-cash-flow mega caps (e.g. META, AMZN) remain the place to hold equity beta, sized for multiple compression risk from R_10Y_1M
energy is the only tailwind archetype (fit +1.1, runway 6/8): the oil-shock hedge
Avoid homebuilders_reits (fit -0.7), banks (see override) and levered small caps until MOVE and the HY spread both turn down
Hedge with index puts rather than duration: VIX 16.3 in contango (V_VIX, V_TERM) is cheap against MOVE 110

archetype_overrides.reason: bear flattening (R_CURVE_SHAPE), long-end AFS losses and HY widening (C_HY_CHANGE +48bp); KRE -8.5pp vs SPY 3m (E_BANKS). The mechanical -0.1 understates it
the mechanical fit sees a low VIX but not credit-tail widening (C_CCC_GAP) and rising real yields; high-beta funding-sensitive names are exposed first
